description.hi: गोस्वामी तुलसीदास कृत पारंपरिक बजरंग बाण — दोहा, चौपाई और बीज-मंत्र सहित पूर्ण पाठ।
description.en: Traditional Bajrang Baan attributed to Tulsidas — full path with opening/closing dohas, chaupais, and seed mantras.

edition.notes: Corrected 2026-07-23 V3: aligned to traditional path (Kavita Kosh / Bharat Discovery). Opening doha निश्चय प्रेम प्रतीति ते… through closing उर प्रतीति दृढ़ शरण… Meanings are plain-language Hanumat originals. Dual-review owner-only.
